critique_quotes.quote: Aims 2 and 3 each presuppose that the transporter identified in Aim 1 is the biologically relevant target; no alternative path is described should the screen fail to validate.
The overall plan is contingent on the initial screen yielding a validated hit before year three.
Completing all three aims in the remaining time may be difficult if the Aim 1 screen must be repeated.

located_excerpts.excerpt: Aim 1 will identify the dominant efflux transporter by genome-wide CRISPR screen. Aim 2 will characterize the substrate specificity of the transporter identified in Aim 1. Aim 3 will test small-molecule inhibitors of the Aim 1 transporter in the infection model.
